title: Event
description: One entry in an append-only, hash-chained stream. Every state change, decision, model call and approval is an event; state and audit are projections of events. Hashing (implemented in P1): hash = sha256(JCS(event without 'hash')), where JCS is RFC 8785 canonical JSON, and prev_hash is the hash of the previous event in the same stream.

seq.description: Position in the stream, starting at 1, no gaps.

payload.description: Event body; its shape is defined per event type.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event; null only for seq 1 (rule PREV_HASH_RULE).
